user.title: Alarm Assistant

data_description.notify_services: Phones that get all messages (alarm, arming, warnings).
data_description.notify_alarm_services: Only get the alarm itself (e.g. Pushover).
data_description.notify_admin_services: Faults of the motion filter and suppressed motion.

user.description: Who gets which messages. Everything else (sensors, reactions, call, presence, cameras) is set up afterwards on the page Alarm Assistant in the sidebar.

data_description.entry_delay: Time to disarm after a delayed sensor (door, motion) tripped.
data_description.trigger_time: How long the alarm stays triggered (sirens, state ALARM). Example: 1800 s = 30 min. 0 ends the alarm at once (not recommended).
data_description.armed_on_entities: Turned on when armed, off when disarmed (e.g. camera motion detection).
data_description.code: 4 to 10 digits. Needed to disarm. Leave empty for no code.
data_description.notify_unavailable: Push when a sensor is unavailable while armed (empty battery, radio problem, sabotage).
data_description.unavailable_delay: Short drop-outs within this time are not reported. 0 = report at once.
data_description.code_arm_required: Off: arming works without the code, only disarming needs it.

error.code_invalid: The code must have 4 to 10 digits (only numbers, the alarm panel shows a number pad).
error.code_mismatch: The two codes do not match. Please enter the same code twice.

data_description.notify_services: Phones that get all messages (alarm, arming, warnings).
data_description.notify_alarm_services: Only get the alarm itself (e.g. Pushover).
data_description.notify_admin_services: Faults of the motion filter and suppressed motion.

data_description.entry_delay: Time to disarm after a delayed sensor (door, motion) tripped.
data_description.trigger_time: How long the alarm stays triggered (sirens, state ALARM). Example: 1800 s = 30 min. 0 ends the alarm at once (not recommended).
data_description.armed_on_entities: Turned on when armed, off when disarmed (e.g. camera motion detection).
data_description.new_code: 4 to 10 digits. Leave empty to keep the current code.
data_description.notify_unavailable: Push when a sensor is unavailable while armed (empty battery, radio problem, sabotage).
data_description.unavailable_delay: Short drop-outs within this time are not reported. 0 = report at once.
data_description.code_arm_required: Off: arming works without the code, only disarming needs it.
data_description.remove_code: On: the code is deleted, disarming works without a code afterwards.

data_description.vacuum: Motion does not count while it cleans or returns.
data_description.fault_sensor: While on (or unavailable) motion does not count, e.g. when the vacuum bridge fails.
data_description.notify_suppressed_motion: Technical notification for every motion while armed and the fault sensor is on.
data_description.dock_grace: Motion does not count for this time after docking (the robot often still moves). Example: 120 s.

data_description.announce_entities: Notify entities (e.g. Alexa announcement on all devices).

data.sound_devices: Alexa devices for the alarm sound
data.sound_media: Alarm sound file on the speakers

data_description.sound: Sound name of the Alexa Devices integration, e.g. amzn_sfx_scifi_alarm_04. Only used with Alexa devices.
data_description.speak_services: Notify services that speak the alarm text, e.g. notify.alexa_media_kitchen. TTS = text-to-speech.
data_description.sirens: Siren entities (e.g. Zigbee sirens). On at the alarm, off when disarmed or the trigger time is over.
data_description.sound_media: Played on the speakers for volume, e.g. media-source://media_source/local/alarm.mp3 or a URL. Empty = no file.
data_description.volume_players: Speakers whose volume is raised for the alarm; the alarm sound file plays on them too.
data_description.reset_volume: Volume set after the alarm sound (0 to 1).
data_description.reset_volume_after: Time from the alarm sound until the volume is set back.
data_description.sound_devices: Echo devices of the Alexa Devices integration that play the alarm sound. Leave empty without Alexa.

data_description.turn_on_entities: Lights, switches or scenes turned on at the alarm.
data_description.close_covers: Covers that are closed on alarm.

call.title: Phone call

data_description.call_addon: Slug = internal name of the ha-sip add-on, shown in the address bar under Settings › Add-ons › ha-sip (e.g. 1234abcd_ha-sip). Empty = no call. Needs Home Assistant OS or Supervised.
data_description.call_targets: Phone numbers or SIP addresses (internet telephony), one per entry, e.g. +441234567890 or sip:**610@fritz.box. Order = call order.
data_description.call_acknowledge: Every number except the last can stop the chain.
data_description.call_cooldown: No new call chain within this time after an alarm. Push messages are always sent.
data_description.call_language: Language of the speech in the call. 'Like the messages' follows the language setting; other codes (e.g. fr) can be typed in.
data_description.call_wait: Time between two calls so the callee can acknowledge. Example: 50 s.
data_description.call_tts: TTS entity (text-to-speech) ha-sip uses to speak the text. Empty = default of the add-on.

call.description: Calls through the ha-sip add-on. Every number except the last one can acknowledge with key 1 (the button 'Acknowledge call' is pressed).

auto_arm.title: Automatic arming

data.unknown_presence: Phone without a known state counts as

data_description.wifi_sensors: Sensors with the name of the connected network (companion app: sensor.<phone>_wifi_connection) for phones without a person sub item.
data_description.home_networks: Names (SSID) of the networks at home, exactly as the Wi-Fi sensor reports them, e.g. MyWifi.
data_description.unknown_presence: A phone that is switched off, has an empty battery or does not report (unavailable/unknown). At home is safer: the panel is not armed while someone may be at home.
data_description.presence_mode: Wi-Fi of the phones: by the person sub items or Wi-Fi sensors of the companion app. Persons: by the Home Assistant persons (person.*).
data_description.persons: Only for the mode persons: everybody who can be at home.
data_description.quiet_time: No motion may be reported for this time before the warning starts. Example: 10 min.
data_description.prewarn_time: Time between the warning (push) and arming. Example: 5 min.
data_description.retry_after_disarm: After disarming, no automatic arming for this time.
data_description.presence_stable: Everybody must be away for at least this time (filters short Wi-Fi drop-outs).

auto_arm.description: Arms away when nobody is at home and there was no motion; warns before. Never while children are alone at home.

data_description.lock_door_sensor: Locked only when the door is closed.
data_description.lock_on_arm: Lock when armed (not while children are alone at home).
data_description.lock: Smart door lock. Empty = no lock functions.
data_description.disarm_on_unlock: Unlocking or opening the lock disarms without a code. States after a lost connection do not count.

night_door.title: Night door alarm

data.night_sound_devices: Alexa devices for the alarm sound

data_description.night_tag: ID of the NFC tag (Settings › Tags). Scanning switches the door alarm on and off.
data_description.night_sirens: On when the door opens, off after 'Reset volume after'.
data_description.night_volume_players: Speakers whose volume is raised for the door alarm.
data_description.night_sound_devices: Echo devices (Alexa Devices) for the alarm sound.
data_description.night_speak_services: Notify services that speak the text.
data_description.night_reset_volume_after: Afterwards the volume is set back and the sirens go off.

night_door.description: Separate from the alarm panel: when switched on, opening the door sounds locally (no call, no push).

data.night_off_speak_services: Announce when switched off by tag

data_description.night_off_time: Time when the door alarm switches off automatically.
data_description.night_off_days: Weekdays for switching off automatically. None = never automatically.
data_description.night_off_speak_services: When the door alarm is switched off by tag, these services announce it.
data_description.night_off_volume_players: Speakers whose volume is set for this announcement.

data_description.kids_reset_after_unlock: The switch children alone at home turns off this long after unlocking (an adult comes home).
data_description.kids_reset_time: The switch also turns off every night at this time.

data_description.hint_windows: Windows checked when the door opens.
data_description.hint_entity: Light or switch that turns on briefly while a window is open.
data_description.hint_duration: How long the hint light stays on.

error.code_invalid: The code must have 4 to 10 digits (only numbers, the alarm panel shows a number pad).
error.code_mismatch: The two codes do not match. Please enter the same code twice.
error.targets_required: Please add at least one number to call, or clear the add-on to switch the call off.
error.addon_required: Please enter the slug of the ha-sip add-on (e.g. 1234abcd_ha-sip), otherwise nobody can be called.
error.supervisor_required: The call needs the Supervisor (Home Assistant OS or Supervised) with the ha-sip add-on. Without it, clear the add-on field.
error.persons_required: For the mode 'Persons' choose at least one person, or choose 'Wi-Fi of the phones'.
error.home_networks_required: For 'Wi-Fi of the phones' enter at least one home network (the name your Wi-Fi sensor shows at home).
error.lock_required: A door contact only makes sense with a door lock: choose the lock or clear the door contact.
error.hint_incomplete: Window open hint: with a door contact, also choose the windows and the hint light (or clear the door contact).

basics.title: Sensor
basics.description: Name empty = name of the entity.

data_description.name: Used in messages and as cause. Empty = name of the entity.
data_description.entity: Contact or motion sensor (binary_sensor, also input_boolean for testing).
data_description.type: Sets sensible defaults for the behaviour; each can be changed in the next step.

data.use_exit_delay: May be open during the exit delay

data_description.use_entry_delay: On: tripping starts the entry delay first. Off: immediate alarm.
data_description.use_exit_delay: May be open or trip during the exit delay (e.g. the front door when leaving).
data_description.auto_bypass: If the sensor is open when arming it is ignored until disarming (bypass) instead of blocking the arming.
data_description.allow_open: May be active when arming and counts after its next change, e.g. motion sensors.
data_description.only_when_unavailable: The sensor counts only while this entity is unavailable (e.g. a door that is open for an air conditioner hose).
data_description.arm_cover: Open but not counting when armed: move this cover.
data_description.camera_preset: Name of the stored camera position (PTZ preset) the cameras turn to when this motion sensor reports motion while armed.
data_description.arm_cover_position: Position in % the cover moves to (0 = closed).

error.already_configured: This entity is already set up as sensor "{other}". Change that sensor instead or choose another entity.

user.title: Camera

data_description.record_switches: Recording switches (e.g. Frigate, a local video analysis). Stay on while the vacuum drives.
data_description.detect_switches: Detection switches (e.g. Frigate). Off while the vacuum drives, in live view and with children.
data_description.name: Name of the camera in messages, e.g. Living room.
data_description.privacy_switch: Switch that turns the camera picture off (privacy mode). On = no picture.
data_description.ptz_select: Select entity of the camera with the stored positions (PTZ = pan, tilt, zoom).
data_description.ptz_home_preset: Position when armed, written exactly as in the select entity.
data_description.privacy_delay: The privacy mode turns on again this long after disarming.
data_description.person_sensor: Binary sensor 'person detected' of the camera; also counts for the cause of an alarm.
data_description.person_count_sensor: Sensor with the number of detected persons (instead of the binary sensor).
data_description.person_image: Image or camera entity; its picture is sent with the push message.
data_description.person_push: Push with picture when the camera detects a person and the panel is not disarmed.

user.description: Privacy mode off while armed or children are alone at home, preset per motion sensor, detection off for live view, children and vacuum.

data_description.record_switches: Recording switches (e.g. Frigate, a local video analysis). Stay on while the vacuum drives.
data_description.detect_switches: Detection switches (e.g. Frigate). Off while the vacuum drives, in live view and with children.
data_description.name: Name of the camera in messages, e.g. Living room.
data_description.privacy_switch: Switch that turns the camera picture off (privacy mode). On = no picture.
data_description.ptz_select: Select entity of the camera with the stored positions (PTZ = pan, tilt, zoom).
data_description.ptz_home_preset: Position when armed, written exactly as in the select entity.
data_description.privacy_delay: The privacy mode turns on again this long after disarming.
data_description.person_sensor: Binary sensor 'person detected' of the camera; also counts for the cause of an alarm.
data_description.person_count_sensor: Sensor with the number of detected persons (instead of the binary sensor).
data_description.person_image: Image or camera entity; its picture is sent with the push message.
data_description.person_push: Push with picture when the camera detects a person and the panel is not disarmed.

data_description.wifi_sensor: Shows the name of the connected network (companion app).
data_description.name: Name for the presence sensor, e.g. Alex.

user.description: At home while the phone is connected to a home network (options: automatic arming). Gives a presence sensor and counts for automatic arming and the garage.

data_description.wifi_sensor: Shows the name of the connected network (companion app).
data_description.name: Name for the presence sensor, e.g. Alex.

data_description.garage_networks: Disarmed while a phone is connected (Wi-Fi sensors of the persons and the additional ones).
data_description.garage_tts_services: Notify services of the companion app (Android) that speak the warning.
data_description.garage_tts_stream: Stream of the Android companion app; alarm_stream_max is loud even in silent mode. iPhones ignore this field.
data_description.name: Name of the garage, e.g. Garage.
data_description.garage_panel: Second alarm panel of the garage, e.g. from Blink.
data_description.garage_arm_delay: Armed this long after leaving the garage network.
data_description.garage_motion: Motion sensors of the garage cameras; report only while the garage is armed.
data_description.garage_tts_repeat: How often the warning is spoken.

data_description.garage_panel: Second alarm panel of the garage, e.g. from Blink.
data_description.garage_arm_delay: Armed this long after leaving the garage network.
data_description.garage_motion: Motion sensors of the garage cameras; report only while the garage is armed.

error.wifi_required: The garage is switched by the Wi-Fi of the phones, but no Wi-Fi sensor is set up. Add a person sub item or additional Wi-Fi sensors under Options › Automatic arming first.
